warnings: Spread footings with no piles (sand bed 0.05 + lean concrete 1:3:5 0.05 under each, printed 'คอนกรีตหยาบ 1;3:5' with a semicolon). All four are square, so depth_mm is omitted; main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b). Thickness: F1 0.20, F2 0.25, F3 0.30, F4 0.30; each sits 1.00 below ระดับดินเดิม, a level that prints no value, so those depths stay on the elements (not in z_levels).

One stair section is titled 'ST-1, ST-2' (shared by both stairs); recorded once per mark with the same spec. The S-02 plan marks them ST-01 / ST-02 — kept as printed on each sheet. Tread width is not printed on the section (tread_mm null); the plan draws ST-01 treads at 0.25.
